rule: A route is allowlisted only when it legitimately has no tenant to scope to: a token-bearing public link, a signed webhook/shared-secret entry point, a cron entry point, the auth handler, a pre-session portal auth step, supervisor-only cross-tenant admin surfaces, or firm-level shared content. Every entry carries a written justification; re-audit when any of these routes gains a new data read.
